summary: ZCode Weekend Build continues (announced Sep 11, 2026 by Zixuan Li): 300M free GLM-5.3-Flash tokens per person, claimable in the ZCode desktop app via the bottom-left event card. Window is Fri 8AM to Sun 6PM PT (Sep 11-13, 2026), released in two batches (Fri and Sat), first come, first served. Coding Plan users can use Flash on ZCode with no quota cost from 8AM to 6PM PT every day. Follows the expired Weekend Build IV round (Sep 5-6, 300M per person).
claim_steps: Install and open the ZCode desktop app from https://zcode.z.ai (macOS, Windows, and Linux builds available), or update/restart your existing install.
Sign in with your Z.ai account in ZCode.
After the window opens — Fri 8AM PT — look for the Weekend Build card in the bottom-left of the app.
If the card is not visible, restart the app.
Tap the card and claim: 300M GLM-5.3-Flash tokens per person; released in two batches (Fri and Sat), first come, first served.
Coding Plan users can use Flash on ZCode with no quota cost from 8AM to 6PM PT every day during the window.
